definitions: A popular social networking service launched in 2004, allowing users to create profiles, share photos and videos, send messages, and join groups.
The company that owns the Facebook social networking service, as well as Instagram, WhatsApp, and other products and services; rebranded as Meta Platforms in 2021.
examples: I updated my status on Facebook.
Many businesses use Facebook for advertising.
She posted the pictures to Facebook.
Facebook has billions of users worldwide.
